content: WebTorrent (browser) requires WebRTC transport; browser peers can only connect to other WebRTC-capable peers, not raw BitTorrent TCP/UDP swarms, so a pure-browser swarm is thin unless seeded via WSS trackers (e.g. tracker.openwebtorrent.com, tracker.btorrent.xyz) and/or BEP19 HTTP web-seeds. Web-seed HTTP servers must send CORS headers for cross-origin fetch. Streaming relies on MediaSource Extensions (near-universal browser support).
